publicStatus.title: 服务状态
publicStatus.subtitle: 显示最近 24 小时全平台请求的聚合情况。数据不足时不会推算可用率。
publicStatus.insufficientData: 最近 24 小时有效请求样本不足，暂不公布成功率或耗时统计。
publicStatus.monitoring: 部分请求未能确认终态，平台正在观察；当前统计不视为可用率保证。
publicStatus.historyHint: 每列代表一个小时，仅显示全平台聚合样本。
publicStatus.hourlyHistory: 最近 24 小时请求趋势
publicStatus.noHistory: 当前没有足够数据绘制趋势。
publicStatus.scope: 数据按整个平台汇总，不包含渠道、模型、商户、用户或 Key 标识。成功率和平均耗时只在样本量达到公开门槛后显示。

publicStatus.title: Service status
publicStatus.subtitle: Aggregated platform request activity over the last 24 hours. Availability is not estimated when sample volume is low.
publicStatus.insufficientData: There are not enough valid request samples in the last 24 hours to publish availability or duration statistics.
publicStatus.monitoring: Some requests have no confirmed terminal outcome. The platform is monitoring this period; these statistics are not an availability guarantee.
publicStatus.historyHint: Each column represents one hour and includes only platform-wide aggregate samples.
publicStatus.hourlyHistory: Request activity for the last 24 hours
publicStatus.noHistory: There is not enough data to draw a trend.
publicStatus.scope: Data is aggregated across the installation and excludes channel, model, merchant, user, and API key identifiers. Availability and average duration appear only after the public sample threshold is met.
